messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] hosted-usw2-gpu-pool-availability < 10% — free_gpus=2, p95_queue_ms=112000, admission_rejected_rate=3.4% (auto-suppressed=false)

emily: saw the alert. opening the capacity dashboard now — can anyone pull recent admission histograms?

emily: https://grafana.redwood/c/hosted-usw2/pool-capacity?from=now-1h to=now — looks like pool-7 is the hotspot (queue depth + node churn)

deepak: checking logs for prewarm/image pulls. last 10m shows a couple of image-pull timeouts to registry-usw2 (504/timeout). could be slowing pod readiness and reducing available slots

maria: KV cache missrate spiked at the same time — prefix_cache_miss_rate up ~5x. When cache misses, more memory pressure -> some big models fail to fit and we evict slots faster

jordan: quick promql to show rejected admission by pool: ```promql
sum by (pool) (rate(admission_rejected_total{region="usw2"}[5m]))
```

alex: two immediate options: 1) enable temporary burst (increase headroom) for hosted-usw2 for 30m, cost impact ~+12% for that window; 2) enable fallback routing to euw1 for non-enterprise customers — cheaper but higher latency. thoughts?

emily: prefer (1) to avoid user-facing latency. I'll flip burst up if ops agrees. also want to mute the noisy alert while we act

ops-bot: Created INF-3421: "hosted-usw2 pool-7 saturation — investigate image-pull + KV cache spike" <https://board.redwood/INF-3421>

emily: muting alert for 30m and bumping burst headroom on pool-7 by +20% (temporary). watching metrics.

sre-bot: Alert muted by emily for 30 minutes

maria: can we add an admission_rejected_per_route panel? right now we only have aggregate per-pool which hides hot routes causing heavy seqlen; I can sketch a small dashboard change

deepak: also adding a note to infra runbook: track image-pull latency on prewarm nodes and alert if >5s median over 5m. might have caused delayed join and slot starvation

jordan: adding a short sampling trace on affected request ids (will push traces to s3 for 1h) — we should be able to see whether those were big seqlen requests or model load failures

emily: p95 queue is already trending down to ~36000ms after the headroom bump. free_gpus climbed to 6. still watching for 15m before unmuting alerts

alex: if this recurs we probably need a small capacity commit for usw2 or better cross-region overspill rules for burst traffic. I'll start a brief cost/benefit writeup

emily: thanks all. keep updates here. if anything degrades, I'll escalate to on-call SRE and open a postmortem ticket.

ops-bot: INF-3421 updated with current actions: headroom bump, dashboard todo, image-pull investigation

emily: updating thread: last check p95_queue_ms=34000, admission_rejected_rate=0.6%, monitoring continues.
